shader.name: AeroSim/Coast/P02IntertidalSurface
shader.surfaceModel: opaque dielectric PBR with optional thin-water overlay
shader.queue: Geometry; transparent water overlay must be a separate pass/material

channels.surfaceMask: linear R=AO, G=perceptual roughness, B=height, A=material coverage
channels.waterMask: linear R=wetness, G=standing depth, B=foam/residue, A=flow channel

materialRules.wetResponse: darken value by at most 18%, lower roughness, reduce micro-normal; never apply global blue tint
materialRules.thinWater: depth-limited local overlay; no ocean wave/Fresnel code reuse
materialRules.salt: raises value and roughness; suppresses where standing depth exceeds 1 mm
materialRules.algae: coverage mask changes color/roughness/normal without changing geometry collision
materialRules.flow: flow UV is local and deterministic; no shared scene state mutation
